newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isuzu Motors rises as investors hunt laggards.
newsitem.headline: Isuzu Motors rises as investors hunt laggards.

text.p: Isuzu Motors Ltd shares cruised higher on Tuesday as investors, especially foreigners, hunted for laggards with firm business prospects, brokers said.
As of 0421 GMT, the shares were up 21 yen at 555, with trade at 3.689 million shares. Isuzu Motors was the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Brokers said that due to the weakening of the yen against the dollar, export-oriented car companies were attracting attention.
"In automobile shares, Isuzu, along with Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd, is fairly cheap, with the share price in the 500 to 600 yen range," a "Big Four" broker said.
Shares in industry leader Toyota Motor Corp were 60 yen higher at 3,180. Honda Motor Co Ltd was 90 yen higher at 3,790.
